## Butter Cuffs

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/bata_cuffs.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user throws a ball of butter where they look. It wraps the hands of the first enemy it hits, who can't hit or use what it holds The butter lasts a shorter time on a player. Hits from someone else break it sooner and fire melts it

## Burning Butter

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/bata_burning.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user heats all their butter at once. Everyone held in the user's butter is burnt, and every enemy standing in it a little less. Then the butter melts away
